classification: outcome-free analytic feasibility scan; not sampled or formal evidence

analysis.risk: exact terminal mean-square parameter error from propagated first and second moments
analysis.strong_fixed_pair: task-by-budget pair minimizing geometric risk over every registered non-task cell
analysis.cellwise_oracle: best registered pair within the cell under the same fully charged budgets
analysis.q_only: cellwise best q while fixing eta to the strong fixed pair eta
analysis.eta_only: cellwise best eta while fixing q to the strong fixed pair q

mandatory_gates.S1: every task-delay pair has a positive common quadratic certificate for the full gain interval
mandatory_gates.S2: all 648 cells and 27216 action rows are finite and satisfy exact dual-budget accounting
mandatory_gates.S3: cellwise joint oracle improves aggregate geometric risk over strong task-by-budget fixed pairs by at least 10%
mandatory_gates.S4: cellwise joint oracle strictly improves at least 60% of cells
mandatory_gates.S5: joint oracle strictly beats both q-only and eta-only restrictions in at least 30% of cells
mandatory_gates.S6: both message-binding and environment-binding regimes contain at least two distinct oracle q values and two distinct oracle eta values
mandatory_gates.S7: environment horizon divides remaining actor-transition budget by q
